steps.npc: I'm just leafing through some designs, waiting for the others to decide what's needed. It's taking them a while, but there's sure to be some engineering involved in whatever they decide.
You do realise this is a military installation, right? Tourists are generally not welcome.

standard-dialogue-attempting-to-climb-up.speaker: Captain Kilian
standard-dialogue-attempting-to-climb-up.text: Halt! Lord Shayzien does not wish to be disturbed.
